articles.title: SpaceX Selects Qualcomm to Accelerate Starlink Mobile’s Nationwide 5G Network
articles.description: SAN DIEGO, November 04, 2026--Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. today announced that SpaceX has selected Qualcomm Dragonwing™ Cellular Infrastructure platforms for its Starlink Mobile U.S. nationwide terrestrial 5G network. Powered by the Qualcomm Dragonwing™ QRU100 and QDU100 platforms and commercial-grade Layer 1 software, the network will combine high-capacity Massive MIMO radio and baseband technology and power-efficient processing to support cellular base station deployment at scale. articles.summary: SAN DIEGO, November 04, 2026--Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. today announced that SpaceX has selected Qualcomm Dragonwing™ Cellular Infrastructure platforms for its Starlink Mobile U.S. nationwide terrestrial 5G network. Powered by the Qualcomm Dragonwing™ QRU100 and QDU100 platforms and commercial-grade Layer 1 software, the network will combine high-capacity Massive MIMO radio and baseband technology and power-efficient processing to support cellular base station deployment at scale.
